place.zh: 石坳村 · 屋后柴垛 · 夜

setup.zh: 第二天夜里，它薄得像一层纸。它要闭关：一颗洗髓丹，一卷《吐纳经》，一个字「藏」。然后化成一缕银光，钻进了吴婆婆的狐纹木牌。
setup.en: The next night it is thin as paper. It must go into seclusion: a marrow-washing pill, a scroll of breathing, and one word — "hide". Then it becomes a thread of silver light and slips into Granny Wu's fox token.

recap.zh: 银月伤得太重，化光钻进了吴婆婆的木牌闭关；她留下一颗洗髓丹、一卷《吐纳经》和一个「藏」字。你泡了洗髓丹，一声没吭。
recap.en: Too badly hurt, Yinyue went into seclusion inside Granny Wu's token, leaving a marrow-washing pill, the scroll of breathing and the word "hide". You sat through the marrow-washing bath without a sound.

zh: 它薄得像一层纸，月光能透过去。
一颗洗髓丹——今夜就泡，疼，别喊。一卷竹简。一个字：藏。
en: Thin as paper; the moonlight shines through it.
A marrow-washing pill — soak in it tonight; it hurts, don't cry out. A bamboo scroll. One word: hide.
A thread of silver light slips into the token.

story.zh:
第二天夜里，她把你叫醒了。

她的样子，比昨天更差。银色的血不渗了，可整个身子薄得像一层纸，月光能从她身上透过去。

⟪**银月**：听着。本王要睡一阵子。⟫

**你**：多久？

⟪**银月**：不知道。伤太重，得闭关。醒一次，就少一分力气。（看着你）在本王醒过来之前，你得自己走。⟫

她从一只旧得发黑的小布袋里，一样一样，往外吐东西。

一颗黑乎乎的丹药，鸽子蛋那么大，一股说不出的怪味。

⟪**银月**：洗髓丹。今夜就泡。疼，别喊。⟫

一卷竹简，绳子都快烂了。

⟪**银月**：《吐纳经》。最粗浅的入门功夫，仙界三岁的狐狸崽子都会。看不懂，也要背。⟫

然后她看着你，一个字一个字地说：

⟪**银月**：**藏。**⟫

⟪**银月**：在你打得过所有人之前，不许让任何人知道本王，不许让任何人知道你在修炼。能装傻就装傻，能示弱就示弱。——你那个吃饼的鬼，编得就不错。⟫

**你**：我娘说编得不好。

⟪**银月**：……你娘说得对。⟫

**你**：那什么时候能不藏？

⟪**银月**：等你把欺负过你的人，一个一个，都踩在脚底下的时候。⟫

她的眼皮越来越沉。

⟪**银月**：还有……本王在找一个地方……一个名字……（她皱着眉，很用力地想）……想不起来了。等你……听见了，本王会知道的……⟫

她的身子，化成了一缕银光。

那缕光绕着你转了一圈，钻进了你怀里——钻进了吴婆婆给你的那块狐纹木牌。

木牌上那只蜷着的小狐狸，九条尾巴里，有一条亮了。

银的。一明，一暗。像在很慢、很慢地呼吸。

**你**：（小声）……喂。

木牌没有回答。

**你**：你还欠我一张饼呢。

木牌，暖了一下。
story.en:
The next night, she wakes you.

She looks worse than yesterday. The silver blood has stopped seeping, but her whole body is thin as a sheet of paper; the moonlight shines right through her.

⟪**Yinyue:** Listen. This king is going to sleep for a while.⟫

**You:** How long?

⟪**Yinyue:** Don't know. The wound's too deep — seclusion. Every time this king wakes, a little more strength is gone. (Looking at you) Until this king wakes up, you walk on your own.⟫

From a little cloth bag gone black with age she spits things out, one at a time.

A blackish pill the size of a pigeon's egg, with a smell nobody could describe.

⟪**Yinyue:** Marrow-washing pill. Soak in it tonight. It hurts. Don't yell.⟫

A bamboo scroll whose cords have nearly rotted away.

⟪**Yinyue:** The Tuna Jing. The crudest beginner's art — every three-year-old fox cub in the immortal realm knows it. Learn it by heart even if you can't read it.⟫

Then she looks at you and says, one word at a time:

⟪**Yinyue:** **Hide.**⟫

⟪**Yinyue:** Until you can beat everyone, no one gets to know about this king, and no one gets to know you're cultivating. Play the fool wherever you can; look weak wherever you can. — That bread-eating ghost of yours was a decent story.⟫

**You:** My mother said it was a bad one.

⟪**Yinyue:** …Your mother is right.⟫

**You:** And when can I stop hiding?

⟪**Yinyue:** When everyone who ever pushed you around is under your feet. One. By. One.⟫

Her eyelids grow heavier and heavier.

⟪**Yinyue:** And… this king is looking for a place… a name… (She frowns, trying very hard) …can't remember. When you… hear it, this king will know…⟫

Her body turns into a thread of silver light.

The light circles you once and slips inside your jacket — into the fox-carved token Granny Wu gave you.

On the little curled fox carved there, one of the nine tails lights up.

Silver. Bright, then dim. As if breathing, very, very slowly.

**You:** (quietly) …Hey.

The token doesn't answer.

**You:** You still owe me a flatbread.

The token goes warm, just once.

label.en: Get in, and not a sound

exits.means: soaks in the marrow-washing bath, endures it silently

story.zh:
那天夜里，你泡了洗髓丹。

你娘洗衣裳的大木盆，墨绿色的水咕嘟咕嘟冒泡，像一锅熬坏了的菜汤。你泡进去的那一刻，就知道了什么叫疼。

不是刀割的疼。不是摔断骨头的疼。是从骨头缝里往外钻的疼——像一千只蚂蚁在啃你的骨头，啃完了还要开个会，讨论从哪一根开始啃第二遍。

你咬住了自己的胳膊。咬出了血。

一声没吭。

一炷香。两炷香。三炷香。

你身上往外渗东西。黑的，黏的，臭得你自己都想吐。一盆水从墨绿变成漆黑，漆黑得能拿来写字。

疼停下来的那一刻，你爬出木盆，拿井水冲了三遍，低头看自己——

皮肤底下，淡淡的，有一层光。像月亮底下的一块玉。

你试着蹦了一下。

「咚！」

你的脑袋，撞上了柴房的房梁。

「你爷爷的……」

那根房梁，离地一丈二尺。

你捂着脑袋蹲在地上，眼泪都疼出来了。可你一边疼，一边笑，笑得停不下来——你原先蹦起来，连房梁的影子都够不着。

你攥着胸前的木牌。

**你**：银月。我没喊。

木牌没有回答。

可你觉得，它又暖了一下。
story.en:
That night, you soak in the marrow-washing pill.

In the big wooden tub your mother washes clothes in, dark green water burbles and bubbles like a pot of vegetable soup gone badly wrong. The moment you climb in, you learn what pain is.

Not a knife's pain. Not a broken bone's. A pain that bores out from the cracks between your bones — as if a thousand ants were gnawing them, and after gnawing, held a meeting to decide which bone to start on for round two.

You bite down on your own arm. Hard enough to draw blood.

Not a sound.

One stick of incense. Two. Three.

Stuff seeps out of you. Black, sticky, so foul you want to retch at yourself. The water turns from dark green to pitch black — black enough to write with.

The moment the pain stops, you crawl out of the tub, rinse three times with well water, and look down at yourself —

Under your skin, faintly, there's a light. Like a piece of jade under the moon.

You try a little hop.

*Thunk!*

Your head hits the rafter of the woodshed.

"Your grandpa's…"

That rafter is twelve feet off the ground.

You crouch on the floor clutching your head, eyes watering from the pain. And while it hurts you laugh, and can't stop laughing — before this, jumping, you couldn't even reach the rafter's shadow.

You close your hand around the token at your chest.

**You:** Yinyue. I didn't yell.

The token doesn't answer.

But you think it went warm again, just for a moment.

label.en: It hurts too much — climb out

exits.means: gives up the bath, climbs out

story.zh:
你一只手扒上了盆沿。

胸前的木牌凉凉的，那一条银色的尾巴，一明，一暗。她说：疼，别喊。她没说可以出来。

你的手，一点一点松开了。你沉回那盆墨绿的菜汤里。
story.en:
You get one hand onto the rim of the tub.

The token at your chest is cool; the one silver tail goes bright, then dim. She said: it hurts, don't yell. She never said you could get out.

Your hand lets go, a little at a time. You sink back into that dark green soup.
